## 2. Dangerous Misconfigurations 🚨

**Five models** are set *above* their actual API limit:

| Model | Over by |
|-------|---------|
| phi-3-mini-128k | 4× over (16384 vs 4096) |
| claude-haiku-3-5 | 2× over |
| gemini-2.0-flash | 2× over |
| mistral-large | 2× over |
| llama-3.3-70b | 2× over |
| claude-sonnet-4 | slightly over (16384 vs 16000) |

**What happens:** Depending on the provider, requests specifying `maxTokens: 16384` will either:
- Return a **400 validation error** immediately (most common — OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq)
- Silently clamp to the actual max (some providers)
- Produce unpredictable truncation

This means these models may be **failing in production right now** if any request actually passes `maxTokens` through to the API.
